standard: houseCARL skill-authoring rule 6.2 (its standard, HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING, is in neither repository today)
method: §6.5 fresh-context agent fan-out; adjudicated on reasoning, not verdict token
anonymized_capability: Evaluating whether a mod that edits Skyrim's 3D world - a city or location overhaul, a quest mod that places content, a dungeon, road, landscape, or lighting mod - conflicts with an existing Skyrim load order, and deciding what needs patching. Covers working out which records are genuinely contested, telling a real conflict from a harmless one, checking whether a compatibility patch already exists, and naming what has to be regenerated afterwards.

evals.query: thinking about adding JK's Skyrim to my setup but I've already got a bunch of city stuff installed. is that going to break anything or do I need patches

evals.note: symptom-led; never says compatibility or conflict
evals.query: since I installed that Falkreath overhaul the guards just stand at the gate and never walk their route. followers get stuck there too

evals.note: quest mod, not a city mod - scope is any 3D-space edit
evals.query: got a quest mod that adds a dungeon out past Riften plus its own little camp on the surface. want to know if it steps on anything before I commit

evals.note: casual, typos, asks for a checklist without naming the domain
evals.query: i want to put a new player home in the woods near Morthal. whats the checklist for making sure it doesnt fight with the landscape mods i have
installed a roads mod last night and now theres a visible seam in the terrain outside Whiterun and a rock floating over the path

evals.note: explicitly wants real conflicts distinguished from apparent ones
evals.query: can you look at ClefJ's Morthal vs my existing setup and tell me what actually conflicts, not just what xedit shows red

evals.note: competes with tool-output-awareness; should win - compatibility is the primary ask
evals.query: if I add this city overhaul what do I need to rerun afterwards, and is it even compatible in the first place

evals.note: lighting mod that claims a patch exists - patch-verification path
evals.query: this interior lighting mod says it patches JK's - do I still need to check anything or can I just install it
already installed a village expansion two days ago. can you go back and check what it clobbered, something feels off in Rorikstead

evals.note: asks for the procedure itself, abstractly but plausibly
evals.query: whats the safe way to evaluate a worldspace mod before i enable it - i keep breaking my save by just yolo installing
i want every iron weapon in my load order tagged with a custom keyword so my crafting mod picks them up
give all the bandit chiefs in my game a fire cloak spell, filtered by level so the low ones dont get it

evals.note: near-miss: mod install caused a bug, but it is the facegen class
evals.query: half the NPCs from this follower mod have dark faces after I ran the ESL compactor on my load order

evals.note: near-miss: performance symptom from a mod -> papyrus-optimization
evals.query: my papyrus log is full of stack dumps and the game stutters every few seconds, can you look at this script
what fields does the ARMO record actually have, specifically can I write to the armor rating or is it derived

evals.note: SHARP near-miss: LOD regeneration is mentioned by the skill but the ask is how to configure the generator
evals.query: need to rebuild my LOD, whats the right DynDOLOD settings for a heavily modded setup with a lot of tree mods

evals.note: near-miss: many records into one deliverable -> bulk-record-jobs
evals.query: build me a spreadsheet of every unique weapon in the load order with its damage and which plugin wins it

evals.note: SHARPEST near-miss: genuinely a conflict/winner question, but on an item record, not the 3D world
evals.query: these two armor mods both edit the steel plate armor record and I'm not sure which one is winning

evals.note: near-miss: dropped-line worry, but it is dialogue authoring
evals.query: i want to add a new dialogue line to the innkeeper greeting without breaking the existing ones

evals.note: near-miss: clipping is a 3D symptom but it is an equip-slot question
